verdict.rationale: Glama's catalog lets developers search, compare, and 'inspect their capabilities' for listed servers. Its no-login browser inspector can exercise any server's tools, resources, and prompts before you wire it into a client. Server pages also show pre-filled connection config. However, the evidence never explicitly says listings expose input schemas, transport type, or hosting attributes, so only the tool and capability part of the story is clearly covered. Missing for 10: explicit per-listing display of tool input schemas, transport type, and hosting attributes (remote vs. local, hosted on Glama), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
